Indian Markets Fall Amid Geopolitical Tensions Over Iran

Indian stock markets experienced a significant decline, with the Sensex falling by over 1,600 points and investors losing approximately Rs 8.96 lakh crore. This downturn was attributed to geopolitical worries stemming from US-Iran tensions, particularly following a statement by US President Trump regarding the Iran deal. While markets saw a partial rebound, gains were capped by ongoing Middle East tensions. The surge in crude oil prices also impacted specific sectors like Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs), aviation, and paint stocks.
